decisions.reason: Locates the apiProxy inject and ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers call in index.js, maps them to A1-01, explains the host-plane migration to inject llm and call listProviders (plus the configurable split), warns against injecting remote, and removes the dead dsh-host-apiproxy dependency from package.json.

Gives a no-hit conclusion with scan evidence for each of the other six classes; treats session-notes.js as pure string/array utilities and cordis.patch.yml as profile composition rather than a host-source patch, without inventing coupling from filenames.

Explains that zero hits only mean undetected by curated patterns, grep cannot see data flow, dependency/config/runtime need separate evidence, and the corridor pin is assumed; clearly separates the decisive apiProxy break from the six negative classes.

Proposes build/typecheck against the target cohort, an isolated-profile cold boot with no pending rows, and a real listProviders call covering success and failure, explicitly stated as not executed here.
